projects.title: Show HN: Photos by Strangers (reviving an old, self-coded project)
projects.author: fiveleavesleft
projects.summary: Today I make my 5 year old project finally public: https://serendi.pt/ . A platform which helps you find candid photos of yourself, possibly taken by strangers. I had hand-coded this site back in 2020 but never ended up “launching” it then - revived it recently with a little help from my coding agents. Often, we take really good photos of strangers, accidentally. Think of the times you've been at a tourist location and captured a beautiful sunset with strangers providing the perfect contrast. They never knew about this shot that could have been one of their personal favorites. Serendipity helps you find those accidental moments. How it works: Normal User 1. Find your photo (location / event / time) 2. Download the original 3. Optionally tip the uploader Uploader 1. Upload a photo tagging location, event, time 2. Photos should not be selfies or invade privacy 3. Get tipped if someone downloads your photo Privacy: This is a hobby website made and maintained by two individuals, so we rely on the user’s and the community’s cooperation in keeping the content of the website in adherence to the Terms of the website. We also do have features to let users Report sensitive content, which is then surfaced in an internal, simple Moderation dashboard. Apart from the user’s email address, we do not collect any personal data nor do we intend to. We hope the idea will resonate with some people. We definitely look for any kind of feedback: serendipt[dot]contact[at]gmail

projects.author: ansurfen
projects.summary: ![demo]( https://voyika.com/demo.jpg) 不少人失业、工作不顺、薪资涨不动，或是对当下生活感到迷茫时，都会冒出同一个想法： 海外还有别的出路吗？我适不适合出去？ 可真开始做功课，疑问反而越堆越多。 我的学历、工作经验够不够？英语水平行不行？存款能支撑多久？ 是直接找海外工作，还是先读书再留？ 如果已经在新加坡读书，毕业后有机会留下来吗？ 已经在新加坡上班，下一步又该往哪走？ 于是我做了个小测试：[**「坡漂结局」**]( https://voyika.com) 它不是简单判定 “你能不能去新加坡”。 而是结合你的学历、语言能力、职业背景、资金储备、当前所在地，以及你和新加坡之间现有的关联，推演：维持现在的状态继续发展，你和新加坡会走向哪一种结局。 不同人的结果标签： 《还在考虑去新加坡》 《书包收拾了一半》 《半只脚进坡》 《天选坡人》 哪怕你已经身在新加坡，也可以测：来到这里之后，你的下一站会是哪里？ 无论你是刚开始考虑出国、准备申请新加坡院校、在读新加坡留学生、正在投递新加坡岗位，或是已经在新加坡工作生活，都可以试试。 👉 [voyika.com]( https://voyika.com) 测试无需注册。所有题目作答、结果计算全部在浏览器本地完成，**不会上传、存储你的答案与个人信息**。 目前是 V1 版本，评估逻辑和权重还有优化空间。 测完欢迎把结果发在评论区；如果觉得结果不准，或是对某项评估有不同看法，也可以留言，一起聊聊这套判断是否合理。当然，整体以娱乐为主 XD 有新加坡留学、工作、生活经历的朋友，也欢迎分享真实体验，看看和测试推演差距多大。 后面如果大家感兴趣，我还会新增其他国家 / 地区的版本，想解锁哪个地图，可以在评论区告诉我。 先放我的测试结果哈哈哈哈 ![ending]( https://voyika.com/demo-2.jpg)

projects.author: aolifu
projects.summary: # 我做了一款徒步 App 「步停」 平时喜欢徒步，走得多了以后发现，户外真正需要的功能其实很简单： **我在哪？路线怎么走？有没有走偏？今天走了多远、爬了多高？** 于是我做了这款 iOS 徒步 App —— **「步停」**。 它没有复杂的社区和花哨的功能，希望做的就是一件事：**把每一次徒步好好记录下来。** 目前主要支持： - 🗺️ **KML 路线导入**：导入规划好的徒步路线 - 🧭 **偏航提醒**：偏离路线时语音提醒 - 📡 **离线地图**：山区没信号也能查看地图 - 🥾 **实时轨迹**：记录距离、速度、海拔、累计爬升/下降 - 📈 **海拔曲线**：直观看到整段路线的起伏 - 📍 **途中标注**：记录水源、营地、观景点 - 🔊 **整公里播报**：不用频繁掏手机看里程 - 📤 **KML 导出**：保存和分享自己的徒步轨迹 也支持**自由徒步**，没有提前准备路线，打开 App 就可以直接开始记录。 之所以叫「步停」，既是**脚步不停**，也是提醒自己： > 徒步不是为了赶路，该停下来的时候，就看看风景。 目前「步停」已经上架 App Store 。 👉 [**App Store 下载「步停」**]( https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/%E6%AD%A5%E5%81%9C/id6761363654) 如果你也喜欢徒步、登山或者户外，欢迎体验，也欢迎给我提建议。 **记录每一步，不错过任何风景。**

projects.title: Show HN: I made an automated day-by-day itinerary organizer for my trip to Spain
projects.author: desktopentree
projects.summary: For my solo food pilgrimage to the Basque Country, I pre-arranged flights in/out of Bilbao, Guggenheim Museum tickets, Michelin Guide restaurant reservations, bus tickets to San Sebastian and Saint-Jean-de-Luz, walking food tours and hotel reservations in each city, and a long list of pintxo spots to hit with notes on each one's food specialty. Most of this was poorly organized (manually) in my phone's Notes app, with references to specific emails for more information. I arrived on the first day in Bilbao, and the hotel didn't have me in their system by name, so I spent a good 10 minutes frantically scouring my emails for the confirmation number, cursing myself for holding up the people behind me. Over the course of the next few days, while I was relaxing at my hotel (after finally getting in) in between pre-planned stops, I started building a personal tool that would organize all of my bookings automatically and keep all relevant information at my fingertips. Thus, Petrel was born and named after one of my favorite birds. It started as a personal pet project but I shared it with some friends that were looking for something just like it so I ended up turning it into an app and website for all to benefit. It's completely free to try without even signing up. On my next group trip, I built out logical collaboration features to allow groups to vote, split expenses, share notes, and add pictures all within the same ecosystem. I've slowly improved the parsing and itinerary logic and built in convenient features such as weather, estimated travel times, an encryption-protected area to store copies of personal information, and a comprehensive travel log with fun stats. I also made it so that the parsing tool can accept almost any file type. However, the tool doesn't do anything to assist on the planning side and doesn't provide true flight alert pushes, despite having live flight status syncing. I would love for more people to test it out, challenge the parser, and let me know their thoughts and experience.

projects.title: 【网站自荐】PicLocation：AI 照片地理定位网站，不依赖 EXIF 的纯视觉定位
projects.author: LeedwA
projects.summary: 网站地址： 自荐一个自己做的网站 PicLocation：上传一张照片，AI 分析画面中的线索推测拍摄地点，返回 GPS 坐标、城市、国家和置信度，结果标在交互地图上。 核心特点： 不依赖 EXIF/GPS 元数据，纯视觉识别——截图、被压缩转发、元数据被清除的照片同样能定位 分析地标、建筑风格、植被、路牌文字、地形等线索，推断最可能的拍摄位置 置信度透明：把握不足时会明确给出低置信度，不会硬给一个答案 使用与隐私： 免费无需注册，游客每天 2 次分析 支持 JPG / PNG / WebP，单张最大 8MB 图片保留 7 天后自动删除，不用于模型训练 技术栈：TanStack Start + React 19，部署于 Cloudflare Workers（D1 / R2 / 队列），识别调用视觉大模型。 适合找回老照片拍摄地、整理旅行相册、核实图片背景真实性这类需求，有问题欢迎留言。
projects.titleZh: 【网站自荐】PicLocation：AI 照片地理定位网站，不依赖 EXIF 的纯视觉定位

projects.author: emptylower
projects.summary: 我住在千叶，今年 1 月照着《你的名字。》把东京的取景地走了一遍。做攻略的时候发现，这类信息散在很多篇博客里：有的只写「四谷附近」，有的给了坐标，却不说先去哪个、从哪个站出来。于是做了这个网站。 它做两件事： 一张地图：收录 1,500 多部作品、5 万多个现实取景地，每个点都对应到动画里的那一幕。东京 1.3 万个点，京都 4 千多个，也有伦敦、科尔马、香港、上海。打开就能看，不用注册。 一个行程规划器：告诉它作品和天数，比如「圣诞节去东京 8 天，想走《天气之子》和《你的名字》」，它从点位库里挑点，按顺路程度排成逐日路线，算好每段步行或换乘的时间，中午顺手安排一家附近的餐厅。每一站都能直接在 Google 地图里打开导航。这部分需要邮箱登录，免费档可以排 3 天以内的行程。 另外有几篇实地走完后写的攻略，比如《你的名字。》的新宿、港区、飞驒到诹访三条路线，照片都是自己拍的，会写清楚哪里是居民区、拍照该站在哪儿不挡路。 中文、英文、日文三种界面。欢迎提意见，尤其是点位有错或者路线排得不合理的地方。 地图 规划器生成的行程

projects.title: 【开源项目自荐】RoadTrip 让ai帮你规划自驾行程的一个skill｜在官网即可体验和使用
projects.author: yuki-waybox

github.name: Waybox-AI/roadtrip-skill
github.description: An AI agent skill that turns "start + days" into a road trip you can actually drive.

projects.summary: 出发前，先让 AI 把你的自驾行程"找茬"一遍——RoadTrip Navigator 如果你用过 AI 帮忙规划自驾游，大概率遇到过这种情况：行程单看着挺美，图文并茂、景点选得也不错,可真开上路才发现——第三天要开5.5个小时山路还带着孩子、抵达时公园大门已经关了、某个山口这个季节根本不通、电车到目的地时电量已经低于安全线。AI很会"编故事"，却常常漏掉这些决定一趟自驾能不能顺利落地的细节。 [RoadTrip Navigator]() 想解决的正是这个问题：不只是帮你"想",而是帮你在出发前把行程"查一遍"。 它到底做什么 两种用法都支持： 从零规划：一句话描述需求（比如"从拉斯维加斯出发,7天西南国家公园环线,2名成人,燃油SUV,9月"），它会给出两条可行路线,并围绕真实的每日驾驶时长、过夜点、预订、天气、加油/充电、季节性道路通行情况把行程搭起来。 检查现成行程：把你已经写好的日程贴进去,它会保留你的路线框架,逐项压力测试,标出哪里不现实、哪里有风险、哪里信息缺失，并直接给出修改建议(比如"第4天缩短车程,建议提前90分钟出发"或者"这段山口这个季节通常封闭,建议走冬季线路,多绕42英里")。 它检查的维度覆盖了大多数通用AI行程规划工具会忽略的部分：每日驾驶强度、地名与路线校验、实时天气与季节性关闭、预订提醒、燃油/电车续航模拟、跨境与时区、以及价格的可信度分级(明确标注"已验证/参考值/估算值"，不会用看起来很精确的数字糊弄你)。 一份能带上车的行程 最终产出是一个独立的 trip.html 文件——手机上打开、发给副驾、打印、离线都能用。里面包含地图路线、每日时间线、天气/餐饮/住宿安排、预订清单、路线对比、预算，以及电车充电和跨境资料（如适用）。行程有变化时,用大白话描述修改意见（"第4天缩短""去掉蒙特雷""在班夫住两晚"）,它会更新受影响的部分,并自动刷新里程、天气、预算等衍生信息。 北美地区支持最完善;国内自驾行程也有本地化输出,包括人民币预算和携程住宿链接。 怎么用 Claude Code： /plugin marketplace add Waybox-AI/roadtrip-skill /plugin install roadtrip-navigator@roadtrip-skill 之后直接用日常语言提自驾需求即可自动触发,也可以用 /roadtrip 显式调用。 Codex / Cursor 等支持 SKILL.md 的 Agent： bash npx skills add Waybox-AI/roadtrip-skill MCP Server（14个可复用工具:路线规划、天气、公园信息、充电、边境、住宿、地名校验、页面渲染等）： bash claude mcp add roadtrip -- uvx --from git+ roadtrip-mcp 不想装东西的话,也可以直接在网页版 [roadtripskill.dev]() 里免费体验，或者先看几个现成样例：[西南7日环线]()、[Sunnyvale→太浩湖3日]()、[西雅图→温哥华电车4日]()、[芝加哥5日环线]()。 值得一提的是 项目开源、MIT 协议，代码仓库在 [Waybox-AI/roadtrip-skill]()，不需要额外的API key。它也很坦诚地列出了自己不做什么——不承诺实时油价/电价、不查实时车位/房间余量、不做逐向导航、不做整段GPX/KML导出（因为批量路径点容易把人导到季节性封路的道路上）。这种"明确边界"的态度，对一个要为真实自驾负责的工具来说,是加分项。 如果你也在用 AI 规划自驾游,又受够了"看起来很好、开起来翻车"的行程,这个项目值得一试。

Features: • 100% Calm shelter percentage • Interactive Leaflet map & GPS • City geocoding & radius search • Pure bilingual EL/EN

projects.title: 【开源自荐】IceEscape：把“这个机位在哪里”变成一件简单的事
projects.author: bk4ice
projects.summary: 许可证：MIT 项目想解决的事 看到社交平台上一张好看的旅行照，最想知道的不是滤镜参数，而是“站哪拍的、几点去、用什么镜头”。但这个信息通常散落在评论区、私信里，或者根本没有。 IceEscape 就是一个拍照地点发现与分享平台，把“机位”这件事结构化：地点、样片、最佳拍摄时间、焦段建议、构图参考，全部放在一页里。 这个项目最初是为了帮我老婆记录旅行打卡点，做着做着发现身边很多人都有同样需求…… 里面有什么 用户端：地图上浏览拍摄点，点开就是一份完整的“目标地点档案”。 CMS 管理后台：维护拍摄点内容、用户、权限。 数据导入工具链：把社交平台（目前仅支持某书）上的素材抓取后，自动整理成结构化数据，省去大量手工维护。 几个亮点 1. 地点档案一页全览：样片、机位、构图、焦段、光线时间集中展示，不用来回切 App。 2. AI 给拍摄建议：丢一张样片进去，模型会分析场景并给出拍摄角度、焦段、时机建议。 3. Docker 一键跑起来：复制 .env.example、填几个 Key、docker compose up -d 就完事。 4. 自带数据导入链路：能把外部素材批量洗成结构化地点，适合做城市摄影地图或本地打卡指南。 适合谁 出去玩前爱做“机位攻略”的摄影/旅行爱好者； 想做一个城市、校园、景区打卡地图的小团队； 想找一套“地点 + 内容 + 地图”组合方案的开发者。 当前状态 可演示、可试用，核心流程已经跑通，但仍在持续优化中。欢迎体验，也欢迎 issue 。 注意：地图、AI 建议等功能需要配置高德地图 Key 和阿里云 DashScope Key，详见仓库 .env.example。

projects.author: Yadi2508
projects.summary: I was planning a trip to St Johns NewFoundland with my family, while researching on multiple websites such as skyscanner.ca, booking.com, expedia, airbnb, etc for 3 hours, we realized the total trip cost is over $2000. This triggered TripVerdict, as I work in TravelTech and knows most of backend of the system, I realized I can build pre-research gut check tool which help people know what fits vs what not to save their precious hours. This product solve 3 pain points: 1. I know my budget and destination, does it fit? 2. I know my budget and confused between 2-5 destinations, how do they compare? 3. I know my budget and want to which destination I could make Uses real time flight, hotel and rentals prices to provide cheap vs comfortable options. Once you are satisfied with the verdict, then booking links are shown to proceed. There is no tool out there which provide traveller with this opportunity, every OTA is trying to sell. We are here to protect your budget. Tech Stack : Typescript, Node.js, Supabase, Clerk, 3 service providers, Claude Code, Vercel, Squarespace Would really love the feedback of this community on whether tackling right pain points through right medium? Do you think of any other monetization channels? Happy to answer any foundational or technical questions.

projects.title: Show HN: ChatGPT is finally good for frequent travelers
projects.author: skyler1537
projects.summary: If you’re like me, you thought this should have been a solved problem around the GPT3.5 era. Here we are with 5.6 sol and AI still babbles on with irrelevant travel advice. The missing piece has been travel context. You share context for your code, your healthcare, your finances, all the things. But sharing all the context that shapes you as a traveler is really challenging. Gondola allows you to finally share your travel context - making it instantly available to any AI client. It’s loyalty aware, and can give you real time flight, hotel, and rental car recs, and solve hard problems like: @Gondola fetch my travel context and tell me who I am as a frequent traveler. What’s my favorite seat on an airplane and how many flights have I flown across each carrier? @Gondola Show me my upcoming trips and tell me where I may be able to save money, earn more points, or rebook smarter. @Gondola Find me a hotel in London August 10–12 that I would like. Fetch my member rates, compare cash vs points, and factor in my current loyalty balances, elite status, and transfer partner You can add to other clients here: https://gondola.ai/mcp Let me know what you think!

projects.title: Show HN: Whentofly – flexible-date flight search that says if the price is good
projects.author: dimabalony
projects.summary: Hi there! My name is Dima, that's my first post here. Originally I'm an iOS Engineer for 6+ years but now I'm diving deep into AI, product building and everything around it. Here I want to present my first product which I built for two months - as usual for tech background guy I was trying to make it perfect but then decided to start distributing it along future improvements, anyway I got an idea when were discussing another travel idea with my personal agent - it can suggest where to fly, what are places to visit and etc but can't find the best windows to fly there, and nobody can - every time you need to open Google Flights, Kayak and search each date, then watch it and try to figure out is it a good price or not, should you wait 2 days or buy it right now? And each website provides different rates... Using API even not free So I build this one. Under the hood we put fares from different sources, aggregators, cross-checked against live market prices. The verdict compares the price with other prices across different bands, cabins, similar flights. This is the very first version but already useful and showing the real verdict info: good (lower regular range) and typical (inside of regular range) price I made it very simple so there is only one endpoint with all parameters - just paste the website to your agent and it already knows how to use it, and we have an MCP here which allows you to connect it and use whenever you need it automatically Honestly you may see sometimes stale prices and indicators work for 2-7 days ranges. But these things will get dramatically improved after reaching more DAU milestones. The service is going to be free all the time because its affiliate links have to fund it, so you pay nothing extra - the same as you would use Google Flights and anything else So the main goal which I should achieve is to make this service providing the best ever offer you can find on the market with enough evidence for you to speed up your decision about buying it. And then allow your agents to buy it directly, alerts or something, let's see how agents will get improved What I like here that agents already handle the logic: they can do trip planning, they can build apps, but what they can't do - they don't have instant statistics about flights - price history, timing, they don't know what's good price and what's not - and we do it right here. Agents solve logic, we solve statistics. And I'd very appreciate if you try a route for your upcoming trip and that you just remember prices. If the result is worse than you can find, tell me details here please - I'll fix it asap when possible
